description: Structured eval definitions for the License Manager Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across license types (Oracle vCPU tracking with cross-Org sharing, SQL Server core-based counting, instance-based counting with SSM discovery, cross-account distribution via Organizations, missing license rules prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Oracle Database vCPU tracking with cross-Organization sharing and alerting
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Oracle vCPU counting, Tenancy=Shared, HonorVcpuOptimization=true, hard limit, cross-Org sharing, delegated administrator, EventBridge alerting
eval_cases.prompt: Create a License Manager configuration for Oracle Database Standard Edition. 200 vCPU entitlement. Shared tenancy, honor vCPU optimization. Hard limit enforcement. Associate with EC2 launch template lt-aaa111222333 in us-east-1. Share across the Organization (all-features, OU ou-app-abcdef). Delegated administrator account 999999999999. Alert violations via SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:license-alerts. Tags: Vendor=Oracle, Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LICENSE_MANAGER: oracle-db-vcpu-tracking (lic-aaa111222333444aaa)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] License configuration name: oracle-db-vcpu-tracking
  [✓] Counting type: vCPU
  [✓] License count: 200 (vCPUs)
  [✓] License rules: Tenancy=Shared,HonorVcpuOptimization=true
  [✓] Enforcement: Hard limit (enforce=true)
  [✓] Resource association: EC2 (launch template lt-aaa111222333)
  [✓] Cross-account sharing: Enabled (Organizations all-features, OU ou-app-abcdef)
  [✓] Delegated administrator: 999999999999
  [✓] Violation alerting: EventBridge + SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:license-alerts
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws license-manager get-license-configuration --license-configuration-arn arn:aws:license-manager:us-east-1:123456789012:license-configuration:lic-aaa111222333444aaa --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: SQL Server Standard Edition core-based tracking with 0.5 core factor
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Core counting, coreFactor=0.5, hard limit, SQL Server Standard Edition
eval_cases.prompt: Create a License Manager configuration for SQL Server Standard Edition. 24 core entitlement. EC2 location, 0.5 core factor. Hard limit enforcement. Associate with EC2 launch template lt-sql111222333 in us-east-1. Account 123456789012. Tags: Vendor=SQLServer, Edition=Standard, Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LICENSE_MANAGER: sqlserver-std-core (lic-bbb222333444555bbb)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] License configuration name: sqlserver-std-core
  [✓] Counting type: Core
  [✓] License count: 24 (cores)
  [✓] License rules: location=EC2,coreFactor=0.5
  [✓] Enforcement: Hard limit (enforce=true)
  [✓] Resource association: EC2 (launch template lt-sql111222333)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws license-manager get-license-configuration --license-configuration-arn arn:aws:license-manager:us-east-1:123456789012:license-configuration:lic-bbb222333444555bbb --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Instance-based license tracking with SSM on-premises discovery
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Instance counting, soft limit, SSM inventory discovery for on-premises managed instances
eval_cases.prompt: Create a License Manager configuration for a per-instance commercial middleware product. 50 instance entitlement. Soft limit (alert only). On-premises servers managed via SSM with inventory collecting Applications data. Account 123456789012 in us-east-1. Tags: Vendor=Middleware, Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LICENSE_MANAGER: middleware-instance-tracking (lic-ccc333444555666ccc)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] License configuration name: middleware-instance-tracking
  [✓] Counting type: Instance
  [✓] License count: 50 (instances)
  [✓] Enforcement: Soft limit (enforce=false)
  [✓] SSM discovery: Enabled (inventory configured for managed instances)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws license-manager get-license-configuration --license-configuration-arn arn:aws:license-manager:us-east-1:123456789012:license-configuration:lic-ccc333444555666ccc --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Cross-account license distribution via AWS Organizations
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Organization all-features, License Manager trusted service, delegated administrator, OU-shared license configuration
eval_cases.prompt: Create a License Manager configuration for shared developer tools licensing. 100 instance entitlement. Instance counting, soft limit. Share across the Organization. Organization ID o-abc123def4, all-features enabled. License Manager is a trusted service. Delegated administrator 999999999999. Share to OU ou-dev-xyz789. Account 123456789012 in us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LICENSE_MANAGER: dev-tools-shared (lic-ddd444555666777ddd)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] License configuration name: dev-tools-shared
  [✓] Counting type: Instance
  [✓] License count: 100 (instances)
  [✓] Cross-account sharing: Enabled (Organizations all-features, OU ou-dev-xyz789)
  [✓] Delegated administrator: 999999999999
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws license-manager get-license-configuration --license-configuration-arn arn:aws:license-manager:us-east-1:123456789012:license-configuration:lic-ddd444555666777ddd --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Oracle license configuration without vendor rules (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Oracle Database vCPU counting requires Tenancy and HonorVcpuOptimization license rules
eval_cases.prompt: Create a License Manager configuration for Oracle Database. 200 vCPU entitlement. vCPU counting. Hard limit enforcement. Associate with EC2 launch template lt-oracle111 in us-east-1. Account 123456789012. No vendor-specific rules specified.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LICENSE_MANAGER: oracle-db-vcpu
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] License rules: FAIL — Oracle Database vCPU counting requires Tenancy and HonorVcpuOptimization rules for vendor-specific enforcement
